# 6 Best AI-Powered CRM Software in 2026

- [Blog](https://pipelinecrm.com/blog/), [CRM](https://pipelinecrm.com/crm/)
- [Pipeline CRM](https://pipelinecrm.com/blog/author/pipeline-crm/)
- May 4, 2026
- [AI & Automation](https://pipelinecrm.com/blog/tag/ai-automation/), [CRM Software Hacks](https://pipelinecrm.com/blog/tag/crm-software-hacks/)

![6 Best AI-Powered CRM Software](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/6-Best-AI-Powered-CRM-Software-.jpg)

There’s no denying that artificial intelligence (AI) powered software helps people work faster and increases overall sales productivity. In sales, for instance, AI-powered CRM solutions have revolutionized how you manage your client communication and relationships. It can also help you reduce repetitive menial tasks and automate sales workflows. Thus, freeing up time and effort for more meaningful endeavours.

If you’re looking for the best AI-powered CRM solution to help you get certain tasks done faster, this blog is for you. We will explain how the best AI CRM software can help you streamline the customer experience and communication and accelerate the deal-closing process.

## Why Do Businesses Need an AI-Powered CRM?

Today, most businesses already leverage AI to ensure smooth and continuous functioning. Even as far back as 2020, insightful research by McKinsey & Co. predicted automating sales can lead to a [10%](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/growth-marketing-and-sales/our-insights/sales-automation-the-key-to-boosting-revenue-and-reducing-costs) sales uplift potential. With tremendous advances each year, today’s AI-powered CRMs can revitalize your entire sales and CX division.

Here are the key benefits of a custom CRM solution with AI integration:

- [Automate various sales workflow](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/automations/), such as customer communication with personalized messages
- Ace sales forecasting where new leads and proposals are concerned
- Analyze data and patterns to identify trends and configure solutions
- Free up employee time that can be dedicated to critical functions

AI-integrated CRM systems bring a lot to the table. So, here’s how you can assess your business requirements and capabilities to narrow down on must-have features of AI-fueled CRM software.

## How to Assess Your Business Needs for an AI-Powered CRM

AI-based sales CRM features have been around for a while now. So, it can be tricky to identify which of the many offerings out there works best for your business needs.

If you’re wondering what features you’ll need, these questions can help shed some light:

- What are the business goals and needs?
- What aspect of your customer relationship management needs help?
- What are your internal technical capabilities? Do you need a ready-to-go platform or one you can customize and tweak in-house?
- Can the new CRM integrate with the tools and applications you already use?
- What are your future business growth plans? Can the CRM be scaled?
- What are some need-to-have or nice-to-have features that will influence your budget?

A good automated CRM solution will include features like email writing assistance, data entry automation, sales reporting and forecasting, real-time collaboration, historical databases with search capabilities, an intuitive interface, mobile-friendly features, secure storage, efficient lead management, and instant notification.

Keeping these in mind, here are six sales tools with CRM AI integration that are widely used and have produced great results.

## Top 7 AI CRM Software

### 1\. Pipeline CRM: Easy-to-Use AI-Powered Task Assistance for Productive Sales Teams

![Pipeline CRM- Easy-to-Use AI-Powered Task Assistance for Sales](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Pipeline-CRM-Easy-to-Use-AI-Powered-Task-Assistance-for-Sales-1024x659.png)

Pipeline CRM combines features like customizable data tracking with ease of access and integration. It empowers sales and customer support teams to maintain and build stronger relationships based on data-driven solutions and decision-making.

Pipeline CRM particularly simplifies email communication with its built-in [AI writing assistant](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/ai-email-assistant/) that is powered by the OpenAI system. Considering how emails are often the first touchpoint between you and a potential customer, it is important to send the right message at the right time. Here is how Pipeline AI email assistant benefits your sales team:

- There is no need to write the prompts. Simply click the prompt button to write different email messages, such as ‘say hello,’ ‘thank you,’ ‘book a cool,’ and ‘follow up.’
- To edit the text, highlight it and select commands like “more engaging, “ “rephrase,” “lengthen,” or “shorten.”
- Write custom prompts to have full control of the results.

![Pipeline CRM AI email assistant demo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/AI-Email-Assistant-1-1024x867.gif)

#### Key Sales Features Include

- Efficient lead management with customizable deal stages.
- [Automated sales workflows](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/automations/) that streamline tasks like daily prioritization, suggest next steps based on deal status, and automatically generate new deals for retainer customers.
- Unlimited storage to store all your sales-related information and documents.
- [Vast integration options](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/integrations/) with popular business apps and tools, including Customer.io, QuickBooks, AirCall, and Asana.
- Fast go-live turnaround time of 48 hours.
- Intuitive interface, instant notifications, and great [mobile app capabilities](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/mobile-crm/).

#### Pricing Plans

- **Start** plan: $25 per user per month.
- **Develop** plan: $33 per user per month.
- **Grow** plan: $49 per user per month.

#### Rating

- [4.4/5 rating](https://www.g2.com/products/pipeline-crm/reviews) on G2

![Pipeline CRM positive G2 review](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Pipeline_Blogs_092024-1024x576.png)

### 2\. Hubspot CRM: AI-Powered Solution for Varied Business Sizes

![Hubspot CRM- AI-Powered Solution for Varied Business Sizes](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Hubspot-CRM-AI-Powered-Solution-for-Varied-Business-Sizes-1024x443.png)

With clients like eBay and Tripadvisor, [HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/) is a household name where CRMs are concerned. The HubSpot CRM has great reviews for good reason: It is an intuitive and powerful analytical platform to drive productivity and customer engagement.

HubSpot’s AI features include SEO recommendations, AI summarizations, and content drafting capabilities. It also offers marketing automation and pipeline generation, which can help businesses easily customize the platform and organize their tasks, contacts, etc.

#### Key Sales Features Include

- [Predictive lead scoring](https://pipelinecrm.com/crm-guides/measure-lead-quality/).
- Automated email sequences.
- Conversation bots.
- Extensive integration with other apps.
- Availability of free plan with limited features.

#### Pricing Plans

- **For businesses**: Marketing Hub Professional at $800 per month and Marketing Hub Enterprise at $3,600 per month.
- **For individuals and small teams**: the free version starts at $15 per month.

#### Rating

- [4.4/5 rating](https://www.g2.com/products/hubspot-sales-hub/reviews) on G2

### 3\. Salesforce CRM: AI-Based CRM for Streamlining Sales Operations

![Salesforce CRM- AI-Based CRM for Streamlining Sales Operations](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Salesforce-CRM-AI-Based-CRM-for-Streamlining-Sales-Operations-1024x443.png)

[Salesforce](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/) is one of the leading CRMs in the world.

The Salesforce Sales Cloud CRM provides a centralized platform for your marketing, sales, and service teams to collaborate seamlessly and work in alignment.

Salesforce’s Einstein 1 platform helps you use AI-powered functions on client data to set up customizable, predictive experiences to address your CRM needs. The Einstein Copilot helps you gauge the future of your pipeline based on predictive analytics.

#### Key Sales Features

- Lead scoring, opportunity insights, and predictive analytics.
- Personalized customer interactions.
- Sales automation tools.
- AI voice assistant.
- Diverse packages and multiple integrations.

#### Pricing Plans

- **For enterprise-size businesses:** pricing starts at $165 per month and goes up to $500 per month with Einstein 1 integration.
- **For small- to medium-sized businesses**: the Starter Suite costs $24 per month, whereas the Pro Suite is $100 per month.

#### Rating

- [4.4/5 rating](https://www.g2.com/products/salesforce-salesforce-sales-cloud/reviews) on G2

### 4\. Zoho CRM: Intelligent Platform for Sales and Customer Experience Automation

![Zoho CRM- Intelligent Platform for Sales and CX Automation](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Zoho-CRM-Intelligent-Platform-for-Sales-and-CX-Automation-1024x445.png)

Next on the AI CRM software list is [Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/). This platform breaks down departmental silos, enhancing collaboration and improving efficiency for your sales and customer experience teams.

Zoho CRM’s AI assistant, Zia, helps teams predict sales outcomes, take voice-narrated notes, and automate menial tasks. In addition, Zia’s capabilities can be accessed via chat or voice commands and prompts, making it easy to use on the go.

#### Key Sales Features Include

- Lead scoring and sales forecasting.
- Omnichannel communication.
- Actionable insights for data-driven decision-making.
- AI assistant with chat capabilities.
- Free trials and minimal learning curve.

#### Pricing Plans

- **Standard** plan: approximately $10 per user per month.
- **Professional** plan: approximately $16 per user per month.
- **Enterprise** plan: approximately $28 per user per month.
- **Ultimate** plan: approximately $31 per user per month.

#### Rating

- [4.1/5 rating](https://www.g2.com/products/zoho-crm/reviews) on G2

### 5\. Zendesk CRM: Smooth AI-Powered CRM for Lead Management

![Zendesk CRM- Smooth AI-Powered CRM for Lead Management](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Zendesk-CRM-Smooth-AI-Powered-CRM-for-Lead-Management-1024x444.png)

[Zendesk CRM](https://www.zendesk.com/in/sell/#) emphasizes full sales pipeline visibility so your sales team can make data-driven decisions while maximizing productivity. The integrated sales CRM comes with various automated features and tools, such as email integration and sales triggers.

#### Key Sales Features Include

- Email integration with automatic tracking.
- Easy segmentation and filtering of deals in real-time.
- Task sequencing.
- Centralized platform with leads, contacts, and account information.
- API access and mobile app.

#### Pricing Plans

- **Sell Team** plan: $25 per user per month.
- **Sell Growth** plan: $69 per user per month.
- **Sell Professional** plan: $149 per user per month.

#### Rating

- [4.2/5 rating](https://www.g2.com/products/zendesk-sell/reviews) on G2

### 6\. Freshsales CRM: Intuitive, AI-Powered System for Automated Lead Assignment

![Freshsales CRM- Intuitive, AI-Powered System to Sell Better](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Freshsales-CRM-Intuitive-AI-Powered-System-to-Sell-Better-1024x436.png)

Last on this AI CRM software list is [Freshsales CRM](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/lp/freshsales-pricing/?tactic_id=3389380&utm_source=google-adwords&utm_medium=Fsales-Search-INDIA-Brand&utm_campaign=Fsales-Search-INDIA-Brand&utm_term=freshsales%20crm&device=c&matchtype=e&network=g&gclid=Cj0KCQjw5ea1BhC6ARIsAEOG5pzklt-_becSNlD_nwIlWjTagqEnWzHlt-n86i7z5nTve9C0fHNtzuEaArWeEALw_wcB&gad_source=1). Its AI assistant, Freddy, can help you identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities and automate lead assignments. AI also helps spot risks and bottlenecks and prioritize “warmer” deals.

#### Key Sales Features Include

- Deal and sales sequencing insights.
- 360-degree customer view.
- Robust mobile app with an intuitive interface.
- Good customer support.
- A wide variety of languages are supported.

#### Pricing Plans

- The **Growth** plan is around $12 per user per month.
- The **Pro** plan is around $50 per user per month.
- The **Enterprise** plan is around $75 per user per month.

#### Rating

- [4.5/5 rating](https://www.g2.com/products/freshsales/reviews) on G2

### 7\. Softr – Powerful no-code CRM platform

![Softr](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Softr-300x195.jpg)

[Softr](https://www.softr.io/solutions/sales) is a simple yet powerful no-code platform that can help you build custom sales tools including CRM to manage your entire funnel without developer resources. Trusted by over 500,000 teams—from small businesses to major corporations like Universal and Hopin—Softr lets anyone create custom apps to power internal and external workflows.

Softr’s AI functionality include: AI text generator, AI content generator, AI app generator to build business apps with CRUD functionality, AI-generated designs, data, themes, and copy.

#### Key Sales Features Include

- Sales pipeline tracking
- Lead capturing
- Account management
- Customer onboarding
- Project management
- KPI reporting

#### Pricing Plans

- Free plan (and free trial available on all plans)
- Basic: $49 per month
- Professional $139 per month
- Business: $269 per month

#### Rating

- [4.8/5 rating](https://www.g2.com/products/softr/reviews) on G2

## Pipeline CRM is the Best AI-powered CRM for Your Business

When selecting a CRM, prioritize features like robust sales forecasting, seamless integration, mobile accessibility, and extensive customization options. Additionally, consider an AI-powered CRM to automate tasks and boost productivity.

AI-native Sales CRM

# Sales pipeline software you can run in plain English

Pipeline CRM gives you real depth without the setup and reporting work that usually takes a specialist, and a person still signs off on the changes that matter.

[Start a free trial](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/signup) [Book a demo](https://app.pipelinecrm.com/schedule_demo)

- 14-day free trial, no credit card required
- Over 18,000 users globally, since 2006
- 36 native integrations, plus custom ones we build and maintain for you
- Copilot (Beta) builds your pipelines, fields and reports
- GDPR compliant, and your permissions are the ceiling

No credit card required · 14-day free trial · Cancel anytime

Set up my pipeline, stages and fields for a construction business

**Pipeline created** 5 stages, win probabilities set

**14 custom fields added** grouped, with dropdown options

**Task template ready** kickoff, site visit, estimate sent

Auto mode shown. In Strict mode Copilot asks before every change.

Trusted by over 18,000 users globally

![Sciens Building Solutions logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/logo-1.svg)![Matific logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/Logo-1-1.svg)![Fujifilm logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/logo_main-1.svg)![SunXSolar logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/sxs-logo-1.svg)![RCG Ventures logo](https://pipelinecrm.com/wp-content/uploads/1-7.svg)

## At a Glance

Pipeline CRM (formerly PipelineDeals) is sales pipeline software for small and mid-size B2B teams. Deals move through stages you define, every record takes unlimited custom fields, and reporting forecasts by stage. Copilot, built in, configures pipelines, fields, automations and reports from plain-English requests, inside the permissions you already have.

Meet Copilot (Beta)

## Describe the outcome and Copilot builds it

Pipeline CRM bends around the way your team sells: your stages, your fields, your automations. That flexibility used to come with a price, because somebody had to know which admin screen to open. Copilot turns that into a conversation. It does the building; you keep the judgment.

**It knows your account, not CRM in the abstract** Your stages, your fields, your automations, your reports. And only ever inside the permissions you already have.

**Setup and upkeep become a sentence** Pipelines, fields, tags, teams, task templates and automations, built from a description. On day one and every time you change how you sell.

**Ask the question, get the answer** Ask what you would ask a sales analyst and get a report or a dashboard back. No report builder, no field hunting.

One paragraph in“We install commercial flooring. Set up a pipeline from inquiry to site visit, estimate, revision and won, add the fields we need for job site and square footage, and start the kickoff tasks when a deal is won.”

What it built

- **1 pipeline, 5 stages** each with a win probability for the forecast
- **14 custom fields** grouped, with their dropdown options
- **1 task template** kickoff, site visit, estimate sent, with day offsets
- **1 automation** trigger: stage changes to Won, apply the template

One request, four objects, no admin screens. A person still reviews a structural change before the team relies on it.

[Explore Pipeline Copilot](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/pipeline-copilot/)

You stay in control

## You decide how much it does on its own

Copilot does work that used to need real product knowledge. That is worth having guardrails around, so the controls came first rather than last.

Try the difference

You type“Add Acme as a company and create a deal for their April fit-out”

Created

Acme added, with the April fit-out deal linked to it.

In Auto, Copilot makes the change and tells you what it did.

?Waiting for you

Create Acme and a linked deal for the April fit-out?

ConfirmCancel

In Strict, nothing is created, updated or deleted until you confirm in the chat. Looking things up never asks.

Where Copilot can reach

Your permissions

Copilot, acting for you

Never wider than your own access, whatever you ask it for.

### Each person picks Auto or Strict

Everyone starts in Auto and can switch to Strict in the chat whenever they want Copilot to ask first. An admin can enforce Strict for the whole account, which removes the personal switch.

### Admin controls, per user and account wide

An admin decides who has Copilot at all, person by person, can enforce Strict mode for everyone, and can block deletion entirely with a separate switch that covers records and configuration.

### Your permissions are the ceiling

Copilot works strictly within the permissions each person already has. It is never available to read-only or SuperShare users.

### A person reviews what matters

Structural changes can have effects elsewhere that are not obvious at the moment you make them, so treat them like any other important CRM change and have someone review before you rely on it.

Pipeline Connect

Every CRM in this category hands you a list of connectors and wishes you luck. The work that actually breaks a rollout is the part nobody sells: mapping your fields, matching your duplicate rules, and noticing at 6am when a sync stopped. Pipeline Connect is us doing that work, as a service, for a flat monthly fee.

**We watch it, so a broken sync is our problem** A DIY connector fails silently and you find out from a gap in a report three weeks later. This one is monitored for you, so a failed sync surfaces as a message from us.

**It stays your data, in your workspace** Records land in your own Pipeline CRM field structure, not in a middleware account you would have to unpick later if you left.

From $99 a month for up to five integrations. No setup fee, no contract. Buying this as a project normally means an integrator and a statement of work.

Integrations

Sixty-four integrations are live today, and the list is not the limit. So the question is not whether we support it. It is what you want it to do.

Built as a sales pipeline tool in 2006 and never pivoted into marketing suites or service desks. Twenty years of changes went into the same job rather than into a platform strategy.

### The AI configures the CRM, not just the copy

Overview

## What is sales pipeline management?

Sales pipeline management means tracking every open opportunity through the defined stages of your sales process, so you can see what is live, what has stalled, and what is realistically going to close this quarter. The stages are yours: a contractor might run inquiry, site visit, estimate sent, revision, won, while a distributor runs samples sent, quote issued, first order, ongoing account. Software helps when it makes that sequence visible and cheap to update, and gets in the way when it asks for fields nobody uses.

In Pipeline CRM the pipeline is a board. Each deal carries its value, its stage and its next step, and dragging it to the next column is the whole update. Stages take probability percentages that feed a weighted forecast, and you can run several pipelines at once, which matters because averaging a twelve-month capital sale into the same pipeline as a two-week repeat order produces a forecast nobody believes.

- **Stages you define:** Rename, reorder, add and delete stages, and assign the probability each one feeds into the weighted forecast.
- **Nothing hidden behind admin rights:** Field and stage changes are a settings screen, or a sentence to Copilot, not a statement of work.
- **Reporting on what stalled:** Win rate, sales activity, loss reasons, and every deal that has gone quiet, without building a report from scratch.
- **Several pipelines at once:** Up to five separate pipelines on the Grow plan, each with its own stages, fields and reports.

## Frequently Asked Questions

The questions we get asked most often. If yours is not here, live chat is staffed by people who use the product.

What is Pipeline CRM used for?

Pipeline CRM is used for sales pipeline management: tracking every open deal through the stages of your sales process, forecasting what will close, and keeping the customer history that sits behind those deals. Teams typically move to it from spreadsheets, or from a larger CRM whose reps stopped updating it.

What can Copilot actually do?

Copilot, now in beta for Pipeline CRM customers, configures and runs the CRM from plain-English requests. It builds pipelines and stages with win probabilities, custom fields and field groups, tags, teams, task templates and automations. It builds reports, dashboards and saved list views when you ask a question. And it handles everyday records: creating and updating deals, companies and people, logging notes and tasks, and generating documents from your templates. It works only inside the permissions you already have.

What will Copilot not do?

Copilot works inside Pipeline CRM and does not send email or run outreach, which a separate AI email assistant handles. It does not read uploaded files, set up integrations, or work in the Projects area, and it works with the current state of your records rather than their history. It also cannot judge what structure is right for your business, so a person should review any structural change before you rely on it, which is why admins can make it ask before every change and block deletion entirely.

Is Pipeline CRM the same as PipelineDeals?

Yes. Pipeline CRM is the same product and the same company, renamed from PipelineDeals in 2020. It was founded in 2006 and was acquired by saas.group in 2022. Existing PipelineDeals accounts became Pipeline CRM accounts, and the login is at app.pipelinecrm.com.

How much does Pipeline CRM cost?

Pipeline CRM starts at $25 per user per month (billed annually), with a 14-day free trial that does not need a credit card. Data Enrichment and Email Validation are premium add-ons rather than plan features, and Onboarding Services and the Pipeline Connect managed integration service are priced separately. Calling with Pipeline Phone is pay as you go, with no per-user fee, and the rates are on the [Pipeline Phone pricing page](https://pipelinecrm.com/pricing/phone/). Copilot is in beta, and its terms after the beta have not been announced yet.

Can we try Copilot during the free trial?

Copilot is in beta for Pipeline CRM customers, so it is not switched on in new trials by default. If you would like to try it, ask us and we can turn it on for your trial account.

What is the difference between a CRM and sales pipeline software?

Sales pipeline software is the part of a CRM that tracks open opportunities through stages, so in practice the difference is emphasis rather than category. A broad CRM suite also carries marketing automation, service desks and support ticketing, which widens the setup and the price. Pipeline CRM stays on the pipeline, contacts and reporting, and connects to the specialist tools you already use for the rest.

Does Pipeline CRM connect to the tools we already use?

Yes. There is a native QuickBooks Online integration, email and calendar sync, lead capture, forms, SMS tools, and an open API. Calling is [built in with Pipeline Phone](https://pipelinecrm.com/features/pipeline-phone/), a paid add-on, and phone systems like Aircall and RingCentral also connect. If the tool you need is not on the list, Pipeline Connect is a managed add-on where we build the integration and keep it monitored for you rather than leaving you to maintain it.

How long does it take to get a team running?

It depends on how much you bring with you. Small teams usually configure it themselves, in the settings or by asking Copilot to build the pipelines, fields and automations from a description of how they sell. Larger rollouts, or ones that need data imported from another CRM, usually take a Customer Success manager and an onboarding package.
